mechanism.claim: joint implied-volatility expansion, an extreme one-hour OI contraction, and a large completed-hour BTC move identify forced inventory clearing whose immediate price impact is vulnerable to absorption and reversal
mechanism.side: negative sign of the completed-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct_from_oicer: OIFAR requires OI contraction rather than crowded OI accumulation and does not condition on funding direction
mechanism.why_distinct_from_ocdr: OIFAR requires a signed price shock and OI flush, has no extreme-funding tail, and trades the opposite direction of the shock
mechanism.why_distinct_from_ovepr: OIFAR does not use premium-index direction or efficiency and requires joint price-shock and OI-contraction evidence

clock.decision: T after a completed UTC hour
clock.volatility: positive normalized BVOL and DVOL bodies with DVOL body strictly larger
clock.oi: raw-time backward-asof observations at T and T-60m, each age<=5m; negative change <= strictly-prior 720h q25 with 672 observations
clock.price: 60 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in [T-1h,T); return=last close/first open-1; absolute return >= strictly-prior 720h q75 with 672 observations
clock.funding: not a signal input; opened only for later exact PnL accounting
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset, prior hour source-valid and consecutive
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT T+5m open, all features available by T
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.completed_hour_price: reuse hash-bound OICER completed-hour feature snapshot; source support may open only [T-1h,T) feature bars
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
